# Favicon Setup

To add your Korvion Media favicon:

1. Create a square version of your logo (32x32px or 64x64px)
2. Save it as `favicon.png` in this folder
3. Optionally, create an `apple-touch-icon.png` (180x180px) for iOS devices

## Quick Steps:

1. Use your existing logo: `src/assets/korvion-logo.png`
2. Crop it to a square format
3. Resize to 32x32px or 64x64px
4. Save as `public/favicon.png`

## Online Tools:

- https://favicon.io
- https://realfavicongenerator.net

The favicon links are already configured in `index.html`.
